name: Riskrunner

frame.name: Arc Conductor
frame.description: When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.

perks.name: Arrowhead Brake
perks.description:
Lightly vented barrel.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.description:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Superconductor
perks.description: When Arc Conductor is active, shots fired have the chance to become chain lightning and return ammo.

perks.name: Short-Action Stock
perks.description:
This weapon is especially easy to grip.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

flavor: Charge your soul and let the electrons sing.
